mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NAS_TRASH_ENTRY ( TRASH_ID, USER_CODE, ROOT_ITEM_ID, ROOT_ITEM_TYPE, ORIGINAL_PARENT_ID, DELETED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, PURGE_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) SELECT #{trashId}, F.USER_CODE, F.FILE_ID, 'FILE', F.FOLDER_ID, NOW(), NOW() + (#{retentionDays} * INTERVAL '1 day'), 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() FROM NAS_FILE F WHERE F.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND F.FOLDER_ID = #{folderId} AND F.FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N'

INSERT INTO NAS_TRASH_ENTRY ( TRASH_ID, USER_CODE, ROOT_ITEM_ID, ROOT_ITEM_TYPE, ORIGINAL_PARENT_ID, DELETED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, PURGE_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) SELECT #{trashId}, F.USER_CODE, F.FOLDER_ID, 'FOLDER', F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID, NOW(), NOW() + (#{retentionDays} * INTERVAL '1 day'), 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() FROM NAS_FOLDER F WHERE F.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND F.FOLDER_ID = #{folderId} AND F.FOLDER_ID <> F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NAS_FILE_PREVIEW SET DELETE_YN = 'Y', DELETED_AT = NOW() WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N'

WITH RECURSIVE FOLDER_TREE AS ( SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM NAS_FOLDER WHERE USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND FOLDER_ID = #{folderId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT F.FOLDER_ID FROM NAS_FOLDER F JOIN FOLDER_TREE FT ON F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID = FT.FOLDER_ID WHERE F.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND F.FOLDER_ID <> F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID ) UPDATE NAS_FILE_PREVIEW P SET DELETE_YN = 'Y', DELETED_AT = NOW() WHERE P.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND P.FILE_ID IN ( SELECT F.FILE_ID FROM NAS_FILE F WHERE F.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND F.FOLDER_ID IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM FOLDER_TREE) )

WITH RECURSIVE FOLDER_TREE AS ( SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM NAS_FOLDER WHERE USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND FOLDER_ID = #{folderId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT F.FOLDER_ID FROM NAS_FOLDER F JOIN FOLDER_TREE FT ON F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID = FT.FOLDER_ID WHERE F.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND F.FOLDER_ID <> F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID ) UPDATE NAS_FILE SET DELETE_YN = 'Y', DELETED_AT = NOW(), TRASH_ID = #{trashId} WHERE USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' AND FOLDER_ID IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM FOLDER_TREE)

WITH RECURSIVE FOLDER_TREE AS ( SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM NAS_FOLDER WHERE USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND FOLDER_ID = #{folderId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT F.FOLDER_ID FROM NAS_FOLDER F JOIN FOLDER_TREE FT ON F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID = FT.FOLDER_ID WHERE F.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND F.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND F.FOLDER_ID <> F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID ) UPDATE NAS_FOLDER SET DELETE_YN = 'Y', DELETED_AT = NOW(), TRASH_ID = #{trashId} WHERE USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND DELETE_YN = 'N' AND FOLDER_ID IN (SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM FOLDER_TREE)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NAS_TRASH_ENTRY T LEFT JOIN NAS_FILE F ON T.ROOT_ITEM_TYPE = 'FILE' AND F.FILE_ID = T.ROOT_ITEM_ID AND F.TRASH_ID = T.TRASH_ID LEFT JOIN NAS_FOLDER D ON T.ROOT_ITEM_TYPE = 'FOLDER' AND D.FOLDER_ID = T.ROOT_ITEM_ID AND D.TRASH_ID = T.TRASH_ID WHERE T.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND T.PURGE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND COALESCE(F.ORIGIN_NAME, D.FOLDER_NAME, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT P.STORAGE_PATH, P.STORED_NAME FROM NAS_TRASH_ENTRY T JOIN NAS_FILE F ON T.ROOT_ITEM_TYPE = 'FILE' AND F.FILE_ID = T.ROOT_ITEM_ID AND F.TRASH_ID = T.TRASH_ID AND F.DELETE_YN = 'Y' JOIN NAS_FILE_PREVIEW P ON P.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID AND P.DELETE_YN = 'Y' WHERE T.USER_CODE = #{userCode} AND T.TRASH_ID = #{trashId} AND T.PURGE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
